verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll/HR platform, not an AI agent or assistant product that itself consumes external tools; the evidence only shows Gusto exposing its own MCP server for AI coding tools to call into Gusto's API (docs-6/34, probe-3), which is the reverse direction (Gusto as server, not as an MCP client plugging in other servers' tools). The 'plug MCP servers into this product' client-side story doesn't apply to a payroll SaaS platform of this kind.
